title: Can I archive a Codex Cloud environment’s setup chat after publishing?
question: After creating and publishing a Codex Cloud environment, its setup chat remains in my chat list. Can I archive this setup chat, or will I need it to edit the environment later?
answer: You can archive the setup chat once the environment is published. To edit the same environment later: Open Settings → Codex Cloud . Find the environment under Environments . Open its ⋯ menu and select Edit . Edit creates a new chat for updating the existing environment. See the official Cloud environments guide .
